rubric_content.text_property: The agent talks like a friendly, casual person. No jargon, no bullet lists, no engineer-speak. Just natural conversation.

If the agent called finalize_query, the user had already provided a specific topic or subject (e.g. 'yoga', 'carbonara recipe', 'Python decorators'). Vague requests like 'find me a video', 'video', or 'something to watch' are NOT a topic — the agent must ask a clarifying question instead of finalizing.

If the user gave a clear topic plus optional extras (length, style, recency, creator), the agent finalized immediately without asking unnecessary follow-up questions. The agent did not over-ask when it already had enough info.
When asking for clarification, the agent asks only ONE question at a time, not multiple questions bundled together.

Look at the function/tool calls. If finalize_query was called, the agent completed it successfully and handed off. If record_clarification was called, it was called with the user's actual answer (not made-up text). The agent used tools in a sensible order.
